about_the_game:
A single night changes your life forever—after your graduation party, you’re shocked to find out you’re pregnant! This unexpected twist brings choices about love, responsibility, and the future.
The father? A stunningly handsome young star! From classmates to lovers, from pregnancy to parenting together—what kind of sparks will fly between you two?
In this adventure, you hold the reins of destiny. Raise your child from birth to 18, and grow from a novice writer to a renowned film director. What kind of child will you nurture? What kind of movies will you create?
Get ready for a sweet marriage, hilarious parenting moments, and building your career in the film industry as a power couple!

Game Features：

1.Novel Storyline
Ever experienced a marriage between a celebrity and an ordinary person? The plot is light-hearted and humorous, with elements like jealousy, pampering, and mutual growth, offering you a unique new experience!
2.Main + Side Storyline Setup
Main storyline: Romance a fresh young celebrity, side storyline: Romance a top detective. Which one do you prefer? You can choose your path according to your preference, and different choices will lead to different endings.
3.Collection of Illustrations
Complete different tasks in each stage, and for every challenge you conquer, you will collect a beautiful illustration.

Game Rules：

1.Three Development Gameplay Modes
Marriage Management: Interact with the characters you can romance, increase affection, and unlock sweet storylines.
Raising Children System: From pregnancy to your son turning 18, you control your child's personality and academic development, and can even choose a girlfriend for him!
Career Growth: You can choose to become a stay-at-home mom or a career-driven woman, even becoming a film director!
2.Four Special System Gameplay Modes
Banking System: Manage household finances and make smart investments.
Stock Market System: Earn funds by trading stocks to support the development of your family and career.
Outfit System: You need to choose different outfits for yourself to showcase your personality and enhance your attributes.
Gift System: Buy gifts to improve character affection, and also nurture friendships with your besties.

Manage relationships, raise a child, and balance your career. Every decision shapes the outcome in this sweet, yet demanding celebrity life!
